# Queen's Pizza & Wings

> Queen's Pizza & Wings is a locally run pizza and wings restaurant at 178 Queen St S, Hamilton, ON L8P 3S7, Canada. The Queen Street South location serves classic comfort-food favourites — pizza, wings, panzerotti, poutine and sides — with value-priced specials and customizable toppings, and is open every day from 11:00 AM to 3:00 AM for takeout, delivery, dine-in, catering and late-night orders.

Key facts:
- Cuisine: Pizza & Wings
- Address: 178 Queen St S, Hamilton, ON L8P 3S7, Canada
- Phone: (905) 577-0900
- Hours: Open daily, 11:00 AM – 3:00 AM
- Service options: Takeout, delivery, dine-in, catering, late-night service, pickup specials
- Online ordering: https://orders.iorders.online/queens-pizza-wings-hamilton-5873
- Popular dishes: Pepperoni Pizza, Chicken Wings, Pizza & Wings Combo deals, Panzerotti, Garlic Bread, Mozzarella Sticks, Poutine, Chicken Shawarma, Caesar Salad, Chicken Strips
